result.post_caption:
An important update about a product I linked.

CooCooBaby baby loungers were recalled by CPSC in June for suffocation and fall hazards, and CPSC has since warned that the company hasn't provided the refund it agreed to. CPSC urges owners to dispose of the product.

I'm removing my link. If you have one, please check the official notices: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/CooCooBaby-Baby-Loungers-Recalled-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Suffocation-and-Fall-Hazards-Violates-Mandatory-Standard-for-Infant-Sleep-Products and https://www.cpsc.gov/Warnings/2026/CPSC-Warns-Consumers-to-Stop-Using-CooCooBaby-Baby-Loungers-Immediately-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Suffocation-and-Fall-Hazards-Violate-Mandatory-Standard-for-Infant-Sleep-Products.
